tasks.question: What are the disadvantages of spending a lot of time on social media?

cues.cue: social media / harm / mental health
models: A major drawback of social media is that it can harm mental health, which often results in anxiety.

models: One of the primary limitations of social media is that it fails to build real connections, and this means people can feel more isolated.
